description: Send another prompt to a delegate that has already finished, keeping everything it read and said. Omit budget fields to use remaining quotas; pass maxTurns/maxToolCalls for fresh quotas for this run. Counts and usage remain cumulative. The wall-clock limit applies to each run. Memory sessions can continue while retained here; durable sessions can continue after reconnecting while retained on disk. For a live session, use `steer`.

attachments.description: Absolute paths of text files appended to this prompt, as on spawn

maxToolCalls.description: Fresh own-tool-call quota for this run; omitted keeps the remaining budget

maxTurns.description: Fresh turn quota for this run; omitted keeps the remaining budget

prompt.description: The next turn for this delegate

saveTo.description: Absolute file path for this run's final text, as on spawn

name: follow_up
